name: an5-workspace
description: AN5 ORM monorepo workspace — lightweight, type-safe ORM for TypeScript, Python, .NET, and Go
author: an5ORM

scripts.build: npm run build -w an5Adapters && npm run build -w an5Client && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w an5Adapters && npm run build -w an5Client && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:full: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:generator -w an5Orm && npm run test:package:smoke -w an5Adapters && npm run test:package:smoke -w an5Client && npm run test:python -w an5Adapters && npm run test:dotnet -w an5Adapters && npm run test:go -w an5Adapters && npm run test:python -w an5Client && npm run test:dotnet -w an5Client && npm run test:go -w an5Client
scripts.test:integration:live: npm run test:integration:live -w an5Adapters && npm run test:integration:live -w an5Orm
scripts.sync: git submodule update --init --recursive && git submodule foreach "git checkout main || true"
